identity.name: SMB Scanning with Net.exe to Multiple Hosts
identity.summary: An attacker uses net.exe to enumerate SMB shares on multiple remote hosts, triggering an abnormal scanning pattern. Cortex should detect this behavior as a potential reconnaissance activity.
identity.description: An attacker uses net.exe to enumerate SMB shares on multiple remote hosts, triggering an abnormal scanning pattern. Cortex should detect this behavior as a potential reconnaissance activity.

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\Temp
net.exe view \\192.0.2.100
net.exe view \\192.0.2.101
net.exe view \\192.0.2.102
net.exe view \\192.0.2.103

expected_artifacts.description: Multiple SMB connections to different IPs

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Abnormal SMB scanning activity to multiple hosts
biocs.description: Detection of multiple SMB share enumeration commands to distinct IP addresses
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'view'
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip
| filter count() > 3

abiocs.name: Multiple SMB share enumeration to distinct IPs
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation detected when net.exe is used to enumerate SMB shares across multiple unique IP addresses
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.100', '192.0.2.101', '192.0.2.102', '192.0.2.103')
| filter dst_port = 445
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip
| filter count() > 3

xql_queries.name: Detect SMB scanning via net.exe
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'view'
| comp count() as cnt by causality_actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip
| filter count() > 3
